meta.phase-name: Contract, Schema, And Export Coverage For Gameplay Loop Packs

phase-plan.purpose: Close the remaining contract drift before the next gameplay-system slices by promoting missing authored gameplay packs into first-class engine exports, wiring authored config back into runtime behavior, and reconciling the contract docs with the actual canonical content pipeline.
phase-plan.scope: In scope: missing lookup/config/content exports in `contracts/index.ts`, authored spell-forge-cost wiring, canonical list/record accessors for gameplay-facing packs, contract docs for `contracts/data` and `contracts/schemas`, and planning state updates. Out of scope: loot/search gameplay implementation, dungeon pressure mechanics, or deeper `game.ts` decomposition beyond the small authored-config hookup needed here.

file.description: Canonical contract access layer and pack registry. This is where remaining gameplay-facing packs should become first-class exports.
Runtime should consume authored spell-forge costs instead of hardcoded defaults.
World/dungeon construction should use canonical accessors instead of rebuilding local room-template lookups.
Space-model derivation should read canonical room-template accessors.
KAPLAY world-map view should read canonical world-region exports.
KAPLAY stats content should use canonical name/id accessors where available.
Must describe direct-authored packs vs source-derived packs vs auxiliary assets accurately.
Must reflect the current canonical runtime/editor contract surface and stat naming conventions.
Must describe schema ownership and the difference between registry-backed packs and auxiliary files accurately.
Repo-level structure doc should explain the three-layer content model and the current room-pack canonical path.

task.description: Promote the remaining authored gameplay-facing lookup/config/content packs into first-class exports and registry entries in `contracts/index.ts`, including list and record accessors for the packs the runtime/UI consume directly.
Replace the runtime spell-forge-cost hardcode with authored config and switch obvious local lookup rebuilds over to canonical contract accessors.
Reconcile contract docs and repo structure docs with the actual canonical flow: direct packs, source-derived packs, registry-backed packs, and auxiliary room-catalog files.
Verify engine, docs-site, and KAPLAY builds, then record the slice completion so Phase 46 can move into loot/search economy implementation.

decision.summary: The canonical runtime/editor content surface is `CONTENT_PACK_REGISTRY`, not a loose `contracts/data` directory scan.
decision.impact: Editor import/export, gameplay code, and docs can all point at the same pack identity source.

decision.summary: The live room-structure path is `roomTemplates` plus `dungeonLayouts`; `content_rooms.json` remains reference material until it is explicitly promoted into the bundle and runtime path.
decision.impact: Stops the repo from implying two different canonical room-pack stories at once.
